criteria.criterion: Access the specified NIST Chemistry WebBook record for water (ID=C7732185)
criteria.description: Information must be taken from the NIST Chemistry WebBook record for water corresponding to the context URL (ID=C7732185). Full credit if the agent clearly uses that record OR if the agent attempts to access it but the page is inaccessible (blocked, down, CAPTCHA) and the agent clearly reports this. Partial credit if the agent uses NIST WebBook but provenance is ambiguous. No credit if values are clearly from non-NIST sources or a different substance/record when the specified record was accessible.

screenshot_context.verifier_justification: The baseline provenance ambiguity is resolved by Screenshot 1 clearly showing the Water record on NIST WebBook. Full credit is warranted.

criteria.criterion: Report identity fields from the record: formula, molecular weight, IUPAC InChIKey, and CAS Registry Number
criteria.description: Report all four identity fields exactly as displayed in the specified NIST record: formula, molecular weight, IUPAC InChIKey, and CAS Registry Number. Full credit if all four are present and match the record (no altered punctuation/spacing). Partial credit if 1–3 fields are correct, or if minor transcription errors occur due to page rendering/visibility issues that the agent explicitly notes. No credit if most fields are missing/incorrect or correspond to a different compound.

criteria.criterion: Report CODATA experimental gas-phase standard enthalpy of formation (with unit and reference)
criteria.description: Extract the CODATA experimental gas-phase standard enthalpy of formation entry (not calculated; not liquid-phase) from the specified NIST record, including (a) the numeric value with uncertainty exactly as shown, (b) the unit exactly as shown, and (c) the cited reference wording exactly as displayed. Full credit if all components are included verbatim and correspond to the CODATA experimental gas-phase entry. If the CODATA entry is not visible due to access/formatting limitations outside the agent’s control, full credit is awarded if the agent clearly reports the limitation and does not substitute non-CODATA/non-experimental/non-gas-phase values; partial credit if some components (e.g., reference) are missing despite being visible.

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: Neither Screenshot 1 nor Screenshot 2 shows the “Gas phase thermochemistry data” table contents or any CODATA experimental gas-phase standard enthalpy of formation value, units, or reference text. Screenshot 1 only shows a link to “Gas phase thermochemistry data”; Screenshot 2 shows navigation/options text but no thermochemistry entries.
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: The agent output provides a specific CODATA gas-phase ΔfH° value, uncertainty, unit, and a reference string, but there is no supporting on-screen evidence for any of these, and the reference wording is not shown anywhere in the provided screenshots. Given the strict constraint to use and transcribe exactly from the specified NIST record, this thermochemistry field is unverified and appears fabricated relative to the evidence. No credit.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: The screenshot shows the top portion of the Water record (formula, molecular weight, InChI/InChIKey, CAS, structure, isotopologues, and links such as “Gas phase thermochemistry data”). It does NOT show any thermochemistry table or any entry with “CODATA” nor any numeric enthalpy of formation value, unit, or reference text.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: The agent’s predicted output includes a CODATA experimental gas-phase standard enthalpy of formation value, unit, and a reference (“Cox, Wagman, et al., 1984”), but none of this is visible in the provided screenshot. criteria.criterion: Preserve exact transcription as feasible and stop after required fields
criteria.description: Preserve identifiers, numbers, uncertainty notation, units, and reference wording exactly as displayed when visible, and stop after the five required outputs (four identity fields plus the enthalpy entry including unit and reference). Full credit if transcription is exact and no extra unrequested content is added. Partial credit if minor extra content is included or if exact reproduction is impeded by visibility/rendering issues that the agent explicitly notes. No credit if substantial paraphrasing alters values/wording, or if the response materially continues beyond the stopping condition.

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: Screenshot evidence is sufficient to confirm exact transcription for the four identity fields (Screenshot 1), but provides no basis to confirm exact transcription for the CODATA enthalpy/unit/reference (not shown). The agent’s output also includes extra, unrequested subfields (e.g., “Quantity”, “Method”, “Comment”) beyond the five required fields.
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: Because the CODATA entry is not evidenced, the agent cannot be credited for exact preservation of that value/unit/reference. Additionally, the response includes extra fields beyond the stopping condition. This violates the criterion’s intent (exact transcription and stopping after required fields).

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: The screenshot itself does not show the agent’s final response, but it does show the identity fields exactly (Formula: H2O; Molecular weight: 18.0153; IUPAC Standard InChIKey: XLYOFNOQVPJJNP-UHFFFAOYSA-N; CAS Registry Number: 7732-18-5). It does not show the CODATA enthalpy value, unit, or reference wording.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: For the identity fields, the agent’s transcription appears exact and consistent with what is visible. However, for the enthalpy field, exactness and correct stopping can’t be validated from the screenshot because the needed CODATA value/unit/reference are not visible. The agent’s predicted output also includes extra subfields (“Quantity”, “Method”, “Comment”) beyond the required enthalpy value+unit+reference, which would violate a strict “stop after required fields” requirement.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: The predicted output goes beyond the five required fields by adding “Quantity”, “Method”, and “Comment”. Also, the enthalpy/unit/reference wording in the predicted output cannot be checked against the screenshot because that section is not shown.
